_about: The single source of truth for this platform: what it accepts and what we have learned about it. Every skill, job and script that makes or posts videos for it reads this file; put new findings here, not anywhere else. maxSeconds is the platform's limit. A video longer than that never goes out cut: the video build makes a separate version for this platform of at most versionSeconds, with its own hook, payoff and end card (data.versions.<platform>), and the publisher posts it only when that version exists.

metadata.text: A thought worth reading without the video, not "new video out!": the surprising fact in the first line (it holds the card's `search` phrase in natural words), one line on why it is true, then a short question that invites replies. No "Sources:" line, no @handle and no links. At most one hashtag, a broad topic people browse (#science, #space, #engineering), as the last word. At most captionMax characters, counting each emoji as 4: keep it under 400 and use one emoji at most.

notes: Threads only fetches videos from a public link (video_url); it has no upload. The publisher reuses Instagram's copy on this repository's "instagram-uploads" release, and removes it once both posts are up. MP4 or MOV, up to 5 minutes and 1 GB.

Text: 500 characters, and Threads counts each emoji as its UTF-8 bytes (most are 4). Only the first hashtag is used, as the post's topic tag; the publish script keeps one. The limits mirror Social Media Publisher ({"action":"platforms"}); the publish script trims only as a last resort and warns, so write within them.
Each How To Hero video goes to Threads as a video post (since Nov 2026), so the weekly promotion pack (ops/PROMO.md) no longer writes a Threads post about the same video.
Posting times (IST) are the same 5 as Instagram: one publish run posts to every platform. Threads allows 250 API posts a day.

The account must be connected in Social Media Publisher (connectThreads) before "threads" goes into the channel's post_to in the Inbox: a platform in post_to that is not connected keeps the video from being marked posted.
